kitDownloadHelp: A layered file to redraw (allow up to 20 seconds to prepare it).
kitSendHelp: Once you have redrawn it: check it, then add a version to my theme.
viewColorsHelp: The template's colours, with a preview (nothing is changed).
exportHelp: An archive you can import again on this site or another.
deleteThemeHelp: Asks for confirmation. Your pages and your works are not affected.
openFailed: The theme could not be opened in the editor. Try again.
mineCreatedLive: My theme created from “{name}” (version 1): it is already online
mineCreatedDraft: My theme created from “{name}” (version 1): not online yet, preview it then publish
newVersionBody: {via, select, kit { with your Photoshop kit} import { from the imported archive} model { from the template} adopt { from an old theme} other {}}. It is not online yet: your visitors still see {current}.
prepVersion: You are looking at version {version} of {name}: it is not online.
prepDraft: You are preparing version {version} of {name} (draft): it is not online yet.
prepTheme: You are preparing the theme {name}: it is not online yet.
customColors: Custom site colours: {names}. They stay applied on top of the live theme, whichever theme it is.
resetToTheme: Go back to the theme's colours
revertPrevious: Go back to the previous theme
stateOffline: Not online · last published version: v{published} · draft: v{version}
emptyTitle: Pick a template to get started
emptyBody: You do not have a theme of your own yet. Pick a template below: “Use this template” creates My theme, which you then develop (colours, Photoshop kit, import…), version after version: you can always go back. Your site does not change until you publish.
emptyLive: Right now, your site is using the template “{name}”.
modelsHelpReplace: Templates never change: “Use this template” replaces My theme with a new version (you will be able to go back).
modelsHelpCreate: Templates never change: “Use this template” creates My theme (you will be able to go back).
oldsHelp: The copies, kits and imports from before, kept as they were. “Make it my theme” turns one into a new version of My theme; nothing is deleted unless you ask.
visitorsSee: All your visitors will see this theme right away, on every page.
customKeep: Your custom colours ({names}…) stay applied on top.
useNewColors: Go back to the new theme's colours
accentWarn: With this theme, the own colour of the buttons and links on these pages would be hard to read (it stays applied):
replaceText: You will be able to go back to version {version}.
replaceHelp: “Replace” adds a new version to My theme (version {version} stays in the history). “Create a second theme” keeps My theme as it is and files the template under “My old themes”. Your site does not change until you publish.
deleteBody: Its colours and settings will be lost. Your pages and your works are not affected.
deletePreviewing: You are previewing it right now: the preview stops too, and the site shows you the live theme again.
